text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer, over here!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate you taking time out of your
schedule.
I really wanted you to attend
this event.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You won't be disappointed! The
performers, staff,
and I are all ready to
give you our best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello's claims are backed up by an

incredibly passionate concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cheers and applause show no signs
of
stopping. The event is a great
success, and the
entire audience is left
with smiles on their faces.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So what did you think about the concert,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Agreed! The performers and crowd both
looked
like they were having the time of
their lives.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
This kind of live concert is where
everything
started for me. That's why... I
wanted to show you
this concert that I
helped organize.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Can you believe someone who was as
unreliable
as me has reached this point?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'm utterly hopeless!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: My projections were way off! Arrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The music was out of sync with the
crowd chants!
And the performance was
faster than planned,
which lengthened
the talk segments and made it
hard on
the performers...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If only we had held more briefing
sessions... If
only I had paid closer
attention during rehearsals!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
After all this work, it still feels like I've
only just
reached the starting line. My
ideal is still way out
of reach...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: No, it is true! Especially when my goal is to—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grooowl...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Mmm, this is delicious!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Look at me, forgetting to eat lunch. It
must have
completely slipped my mind.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I will! What would be the point if I
collapsed
from—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sorry, I just gave myself deja vu.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Remember our first day out together?
My
stomach was rumbling something
fierce then, too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
My work has mostly been on track since
that time.
But you've gone on to achieve
even greater
things.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And yet here I am, making the same
mistakes.
Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
There are still times I overdo it. Even
when I
should be taking a break, I end
up doing extra
work.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And each time it happens, I'm reminded
that I
have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
But... I've learned something very
important.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You've taught me the value of
depending on
others!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'll be relying on you from here on out,
too. And
I'll probably cause you a fair
bit of grief.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
But when that happens... could we meet
up like
this again?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I promise to grow as a person. So that
one day, I'll
be able to support you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Let's create many more memories
together,
Trainer!

Let's create many more memories
together,
Trainer!
